guard: a hosted Cotal connection stays with the Claude Code session that opened it: a fork is refused the id, while the opener, its subagents, a resume and an unseen id pass
why: Reproduced live on Claude Code 2.1.295: a session connected through a hosted gateway stand-in as fork_parent, and `claude --resume <id> --fork-session` reused its connection_id and acted as fork_parent from a new session id.
The suite runs dist/hook.cjs, the file hooks.json runs, and records the real gateway's cotal_connect answer, so every mutation rebuilds before the run and after the restore.

C1 and C6 cut recording; C2 is the liveness arm (refusing the opener too); C3 drops the refusal; C4 drops the file-name check; C5 keeps a disconnected record; C7 narrows the hooks.json matcher; C8 records in a launched session; C9 refuses only the tools the earlier cells named; C10 lets any session's disconnect release the record.

mutations.name: C1 the opener's connect is never recorded
mutations.expectRed: the opening session's PostToolUse records it as the owner
mutations.cell: the opening session's PostToolUse records it as the owner

mutations.name: C2 the owner check ignores which session asks
mutations.find: if (recorded === undefined || recorded === sessionId) return undefined;
mutations.note: Liveness: every refusal cell stays green; only the opener's pass catches a guard that refuses everyone.

mutations.name: C3 a recorded owner is never enforced
mutations.find: if (recorded === undefined || recorded === sessionId) return undefined;
mutations.expectRed: another session (a fork) is refused the opener's connection_id
mutations.cell: another session (a fork) is refused the opener's connection_id
mutations.note: The pre-fix behavior: the fork acts under the opener's name.

mutations.name: C4 any id the gateway text carries becomes a file name
mutations.find: if (id !== undefined) return SAFE_ID.test(id) ? id : undefined;
mutations.expectRed: an id that is not a plain token is never written
mutations.cell: an id that is not a plain token is never written

mutations.name: C5 disconnect keeps the record
mutations.find: if (owner() === sessionId) rmSync(join(dir, id), { force: true });
mutations.expectRed: the opener's disconnect releases the record
mutations.cell: the opener's disconnect releases the record

mutations.name: C6 the hook does not run the owner answer
mutations.expectRed: the opening session's PostToolUse records it as the owner
mutations.cell: the opening session's PostToolUse records it as the owner

mutations.name: C7 hooks.json stops running the hook for cotal_disconnect
mutations.expectRed: hooks.json runs the hook on PostToolUse for a hosted cotal_connect and cotal_disconnect
mutations.cell: hooks.json runs the hook on PostToolUse for a hosted cotal_connect and cotal_disconnect, and not for other tools
mutations.note: The bundle cells call the hook directly, so only this cell sees what Claude Code would actually run it for.

mutations.name: C8 a launched session records hosted connects
mutations.cell: a launched session records nothing (its hosted calls are refused before use)

mutations.name: C9 the refusal covers only cotal_roster and cotal_disconnect
mutations.expectRed: another session is refused cotal_send on it, as every hosted tool
mutations.cell: another session is refused cotal_send on it, as every hosted tool
mutations.note: A review found this survived when only roster and disconnect were checked from a fork.

mutations.name: C10 any session's disconnect releases the record
mutations.find: if (owner() === sessionId) rmSync(join(dir, id), { force: true });
mutations.expectRed: another session's disconnect leaves the opener's record
mutations.cell: another session's disconnect leaves the opener's record
mutations.note: A review found this survived when only the opener disconnected.
